p: The SendAsynchronous Job processes COB events before start-of-day events, prioritizing events by business date. It marks events from TO_BE_SENT to SENT using parallel commits.
Message size limits and replay behavior:

ul.li: A BulkMessage that could exceed 100KB for a large Loan with many revert-replay transactions is split into multiple messages.
Replay and reprocessing includes chronological reprocessing and re-applying transactions according to their submitted date during reverse-replay.
